thread:
Noah Li: Heads-up  Azure marketplace invoice for Sept shows a seat-proration variance for reseller GreenWave. Invoice line item for monthly seats is 0.00 USD but partner statement shows $6,720 of proration charges. PDF: https://s3.redwood.internal/invoices/azure/2026-09/GW-INV-0912.pdf
Tara Benson: that's odd. did we change proration logic in the marketplace ingestion last week? cc @Omar Khalid
Omar Khalid: we toggled `proration_v2` on 2026-09-05 as part of pricing experiments. suspect the new schema writes proration to a nested adjustments array which our legacy importer ignores.
Noah Li: can we get a quick impact estimate?
Omar Khalid: partner claims ~$6.7k. my rough check: 560 seats * partial-month fraction * $0.015/seat-hour ~= $6,720.
Tara Benson: @finance-bot please open ticket and place provisional hold for full amount until reconciliation done.
finance-bot: Ticket FIN-4827 created. Provisional hold of $6,720 placed. Auto-bill paused for GreenWave for Sept.
Omar Khalid: partner export snippet (redacted):
```
invoice_id,line_type,amount,meta
inv_3342,proration,6720,{"period":"2026-09","proration_schema":"v2"}
```
Our legacy importer only reads `line_type` at top-level and missed nested `proration` entries.
Tara Benson: billing-ops - can you re-run importer with schema v2 enabled for a canary and post diffs to FIN-4827? Need ETA.
billing-ops: Ack. Will run canary import for GreenWave in staging and post results. ETA 90m.
azure-partner: Confirmed we shipped proration_v2 to exports. The intention was to separate proration from base seat lines. We'll share raw CSV bundle via secure link.
Omar Khalid: ran the canary import - it surfaces the missing proration lines. Diff: add 1 line for $6,720, no other deltas. Attaching reconciliation CSV to FIN-4827.
Noah Li: recommend provisional approval to allow ops to issue credit if needed and to adjust recognition. Approving up to $7,000 to cover rounding variance. @Tara can you sign off?
Tara Benson: Signed. Approving provisional up to $7,000. Please reflect in Sep accrual adjustments and notify recognition team.
azure-partner: Thanks for quick turnaround. We'll update our exporter docs so downstreams don't miss nested adjustment types.
billing-ops: Applied corrected import in staging; scheduling production run with schema flag on tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Will notify when complete.
finance-bot: FIN-4827 updated: provisional memo generated. Status: awaiting final partner ledger confirmation.
Omar Khalid: partner confirmed ledger, production import applied, final net impact = $6,720 credit issued to GreenWave. Exported credit memo attached to FIN-4827.
Noah Li: excellent. please file a short postmortem action: require experiments team to announce schema changes to billing-subscribers and add ingestion tests for nested adjustments.
Tara Benson: creating postmortem and linking FIN-4827. Closing thread when FIN ticket is resolved. :white_check_mark:
